card.title: 10th GUARDS REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 10th Rifle Regiment was attached to the 45th Rifle Division that was formed in 1919 during the Russian Civil War. The division participated in the Polish-Soviet War (1919-21) and the Soviet Invasion of Poland in 1939. The division was destroyed in 1941 during Operation Barbarossa, but reformed in 1942 and sent to fight in the Battle of Stalingrad. The division was designated the 74th Guards Rifle Division in 1943 and participated in several battles and operations before it was disbanded in 1946.
